source_state: HEAD plus the shared working tree; this agent did not create a commit

checks.name: Core runtime API integration
covers: Plan-first allows reads, refuses an early write, and executes the write after a persisted visible plan
Spec requires three human document decisions in full-access and delegated-approval modes
Spec approval exposes the complete document and refuses run-wide approval scope
Spec works without a project and composes with a published workflow
Workflow planner input contains all three confirmed specification bodies and their confirmed-state instruction
Workflow without multi-agent collaboration is rejected before any model call
A captured null conversation-model override does not read a later session override
Independent worktree setup precedes model work, routes tools to the assigned root, and preserves the directory
Worktree setup failure performs no task tool call in the original checkout
Worktree composes with a workflow and the planner receives its actual execution root
Loss of a real worktree assignment causes the scope resolver to refuse original-root fallback
Bulletin board restrictions are per run/call, cover aliases and room ids, and retain history
Run and session orchestration projections use the run's frozen graph
A per-turn mode snapshot does not overwrite a newer session default

checks.name: Core policy and affected orchestration regression
covers: Write-before-plan enforcement and disabled-planning behavior
A model-provided call id cannot impersonate Core's worktree provisioning step
Specification stage ordering and implementation gating
Multi-agent tool and spawn-authority narrowing
Complete Unicode specification review text survives encode/decode within the durable digest budget
Oversized specifications are refused rather than truncated
Frozen graph validation, approval evidence, and queue payload parsing

semantics.scope: Session choices apply to future submissions; each queued message carries its submitted choices and each admitted run freezes resolved resources and policies
semantics.flat: Published presets retain their distinct behavior, including read-only Plan
semantics.space: All spatial sessions resolve composable options; there is no null-options path back to preset execution
semantics.planning: Workspace mutations and executor dispatch require a visible plan when plan-first is enabled; read-only investigation and simple answers do not
semantics.specification: Requirements, design, and tasks are reviewed in order; confirmed content, content hash, revision, and approval execution are durable run facts; the tasks checklist supplies the visible plan
semantics.context: Confirmed specification bodies and the actual worktree root are passed to initial planning, replanning, workers, supervision, finalization, and operational-role context
semantics.workflow: Published graph resources constrain dispatch; preparation capabilities come from a compatible published resource with the same conversation-agent version
semantics.worktree: One Core-provisioned worktree per run, through ordinary tool authorization and approval; no automatic merge or directory removal
semantics.bulletin_board: Run-local read/post restrictions preserve session history and direct governance channels

limits: Each specification document is limited to 3000 characters, and its stage/document JSON to 3584 characters, so the complete review fits the existing 4096-character durable digest column
The specification checklist contains 1 to 20 steps; already confirmed stage content is immutable within that run
Workflow preparation requires compatible published resources; unavailable or conflicting combinations are refused
Worktrees start from the existing tool's default HEAD behavior; task completion releases ownership but retains worktree files and does not merge changes
Integration tests use scripted chat clients and a fake tool provider for execution-root observations, with real Core APIs, persistence, approvals, leases, and temporary Git repositories
No paid model calls, real-model task-quality evaluation, native worktree creation end-to-end run, or cross-platform installer acceptance was performed
historical_evidence: runtime-api-before-planner-context.trx records the earlier successful matrix before the planner-context correction; runtime-api-final.trx is authoritative for the final implementation
